entities.name: Allied military government period
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: Period in the history of korea (1945–1948) when it was under military administration by the soviet union (north of the 38th parallel north) and the united states (south of the 38th parallel north) (1945-08-15 – 1948-09-09). Allied military government period is a historical period associated with Asia, spanning 1945-08-15 to 1948-09-09.
